rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 5 and 6 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-008, -p1-010, -p1-011): the prototype wins by default, so a general start asks DR2.1's notification type question with its copy and options; only a real constraint the prototype cannot express overrides it, and cross-service behaviour and persistence are such constraints here (the real services split journeys by type, each creating its own draft and reference, and no service takes germinal products), so each type goes to the real service that takes it; claim 2 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-002) has the hosting service worked out from the evidence, which makes the INS front door, the only type-agnostic all-types dashboard whose start (c-147, settled) leads to the type choice, its host.
outcome: The prototype wins on the question itself: a start from the all-types dashboard asks 'What are you importing?' with DR2.1's title, caption, Back link, radios and Continue button before any draft exists. The evidence puts it in the INS front door, whose all-types dashboard start today goes straight into the animals frontend (/live-animals) and already knows the plants frontend's address. Cross-service and persistence constraints override the prototype's routing, where every type continues to the live-animals origin page with a GBN-AG reference: Live animals continues to the animals frontend's existing start, which creates the GBN-AG draft and lands on origin, and origin's Back link returns to the type question. Plants for planting, Potatoes (seed and ware) and Wood products continue to the start of the high-risk plants journey in trade-imports-plants-frontend, the service that notifies high-risk plants, potatoes and wood under the Plant Health National Notification Scheme. Germinal products is left off the list, as no real service takes it, until one can. The animals frontend's own live-animals dashboard is the category dashboard and its start skips the question. Re-selecting a type on return applies only where the notification already exists, within the live-animals journey. Template creation's type question offers the same options as the create one and then leads to the template name page. No non-live-animals type runs through the live-animals pages.
